description:
GOAL: Make `c_pointer` and `c_string` the sole fz spellings for the builtin C pointer and NUL-terminated C-string ABI types.

SIGNAL:
- source declarations, resource contracts, diagnostics, fixtures, and guides use `c_pointer` and `c_string`
- the old compact spellings are rejected, rather than retained as silent aliases
- all three execution doors preserve the existing raw pointer and NUL-terminated binary ABI behavior

STRATEGY: Rename the builtin resolver spelling and every public reference together; pin accepted/rejected front-door behavior and retain the existing ABI lanes.
title: Normalize FFI C type spellings
